text: Here, I find myself surrounded by glass, color, and an aura of curiosity. The world seems modern and structured, yet there is a playful invitation to explore what lies beyond the transparent walls. The acronym 'R+D' speaks to ongoing creation—a perpetual inquiry into newness. I feel a quiet, contemplative excitement about the endless possibilities for learning and reimagining. What does it mean to research and develop? To respond and innovate? In this space, I sense both the drive for discovery and the calm before an idea takes shape.
